episode_title: The Strategic Payroll Leader | Beyond Compliance at Payroll Summit 2026 with Vickie Graham
question: What skills are changing for payroll and reward professionals according to the Reward and Payroll Summit 2026?
transcript_excerpt: The skills required of pay and reward professionals are developing into almost marketing skills, including communication pieces. Professionals are now using personas—something from marketing—to align what organizations are offering as motivators and incentives to different life stages and employee groups, freeing up time from automation for strategic discussions, data analytics, and new project implementation.

episode_title: The Strategic Payroll Leader | Beyond Compliance at Payroll Summit 2026 with Vickie Graham
question: What percentage of payroll professionals at the Reward and Payroll Summit 2026 wanted involvement in strategic leadership conversations?
transcript_excerpt: 99% of the room put their hands up when asked how many wanted to be involved in the leadership conversation and strategic conversations that impact payroll. This was notable because when asked separately how many wanted to be a chief payroll officer, only about 10 people raised their hands—showing payroll professionals want strategic involvement without necessarily aspiring to the C-suite title.

episode_title: The Strategic Payroll Leader | Beyond Compliance at Payroll Summit 2026 with Vickie Graham
question: What measurable outcomes do judges look for when evaluating Reward and Payroll Summit award nominations?
transcript_excerpt: Judges look for measures of success demonstrating positive impact on the business at a strategic level, supported by evidence and statistics showing transformation: where the organization was, where it is now, and how they got there. Winning nominations include stats backing up claims and supporting documentation that makes or breaks a nomination.

episode_title: The Strategic Payroll Leader | Beyond Compliance at Payroll Summit 2026 with Vickie Graham
question: How much time did Champneys automation project save in the Reward and Payroll Summit 2026 award winner case?
transcript_excerpt: Champneys won a transformation project award; while the exact numbers are not specified in the discussion, the time saved through automation and processes developed with their supplier were significant enough to impact not only payroll team efficiency with time and cost savings, but also enable them to redirect efforts into workforce management and workforce planning using their payroll data.

episode_title: The Strategic Payroll Leader | Beyond Compliance at Payroll Summit 2026 with Vickie Graham
question: What post-award process does Reward Strategy use to create case studies from the Reward and Payroll Summit 2026?
transcript_excerpt: Reward Strategy contacts those who achieved over 90% (scoring on a zero to 100 scale) to pull together case studies that produce content throughout the next year ahead of the next event, continuing the opportunity for the profession to learn from what award winners have done.

question: How many people attended the Reward and Payroll Summit 2026 awards ceremony evening?
